## Articles (English)
### AI for everyone
- [What Is AI? A Simple Explanation for Beginners](https://muchson.web.id/en/articles/what-is-ai-for-beginners/): What AI is, how it differs from machine learning and generative AI, examples you already use every day, and what AI still cannot do reliably.
- [How to Use ChatGPT for Beginners: Your First Steps](https://muchson.web.id/en/articles/how-to-use-chatgpt-for-beginners/): Use ChatGPT from scratch: how to ask, tasks that suit beginners, common beginner mistakes and the limits to know so you are not misled by its answers.
- [AI Agent vs Chatbot: What's the Difference and When to Use One](https://muchson.web.id/en/articles/ai-agent-vs-chatbot/): A chatbot answers, an AI agent acts. Understand the difference, real examples, the risks and a short test to pick the right one for your business or work.
- [What Is MCP (Model Context Protocol)? A Simple Explanation](https://muchson.web.id/en/articles/what-is-mcp-model-context-protocol/): MCP is a standard that connects AI assistants to your data and tools. Understand how it works with a simple analogy, usage examples and what to watch out for.

### Automation and AI agents
- [n8n for Beginners: Workflow Automation Without the Hassle](https://muchson.web.id/en/articles/n8n-workflow-automation-for-beginners/): Meet n8n, a visual automation platform you can host yourself. Learn triggers and nodes, example workflows and when n8n beats writing code.
- [Build an AI Agent with n8n: Step by Step](https://muchson.web.id/en/articles/build-an-ai-agent-with-n8n/): A guide to assembling an AI agent in n8n: choosing a narrow task, a model, tools, memory and safety limits so the agent does not act out of control.
- [Claude Code for Beginners: What It Is and How to Start](https://muchson.web.id/en/articles/claude-code-for-beginners/): Claude Code is a coding agent that works directly in your project folder. Understand how it works, a safe way to use it and its limits.

### Learning to code and designing training
- [Python Learning Roadmap from Zero: Order and Practice](https://muchson.web.id/en/articles/python-learning-roadmap-from-scratch/): A sensible order for learning Python as a beginner, from variables to a first project, with weekly targets, exercises and the common mistakes that make people quit.
- [Designing a Training Curriculum: ADDIE and Bloom's Taxonomy](https://muchson.web.id/en/articles/designing-a-training-curriculum-addie-and-blooms-taxonomy/): How to design an effective training curriculum: the ADDIE framework, learning objectives with Bloom's taxonomy and a learning-objective builder.
- [A Developer Portfolio Recruiters Notice: Contents, Examples](https://muchson.web.id/en/articles/developer-portfolio-recruiters-notice/): What goes in a portfolio that recruiters notice, how to write project case studies, the mistakes that get it ignored and a full checklist.
- [All English articles](https://muchson.web.id/en/articles/)

## Artikel (Indonesia)
### AI untuk Semua
- [Apa Itu AI? Penjelasan Sederhana untuk Pemula](https://muchson.web.id/artikel/apa-itu-ai-kecerdasan-buatan-untuk-pemula/): Apa itu AI, bedanya dengan machine learning dan generative AI, contoh yang sudah Anda pakai sehari-hari, dan apa yang AI belum bisa lakukan.
- [Cara Menggunakan ChatGPT untuk Pemula: Langkah Pertama](https://muchson.web.id/artikel/cara-menggunakan-chatgpt-untuk-pemula/): Panduan memakai ChatGPT dari nol: cara bertanya, contoh tugas yang cocok, kesalahan umum pemula, dan batasan yang perlu Anda ketahui agar tidak tertipu jawabannya.
- [AI Agent vs Chatbot: Apa Bedanya dan Kapan Memakainya](https://muchson.web.id/artikel/ai-agent-vs-chatbot-apa-bedanya/): Chatbot menjawab, AI agent bertindak. Pahami perbedaan, contoh nyata, risiko, dan tes singkat untuk memilih yang tepat bagi kebutuhan bisnis atau pekerjaan Anda.
- [Apa Itu MCP (Model Context Protocol)? Penjelasan Sederhana](https://muchson.web.id/artikel/apa-itu-mcp-model-context-protocol-pemula/): MCP adalah standar yang menghubungkan asisten AI ke data dan alat Anda. Pahami cara kerjanya dengan analogi sederhana, contoh pemakaian, dan hal yang perlu diwaspadai.

### Otomasi dan agen AI
- [n8n untuk Pemula: Otomasi Workflow Tanpa Ribet](https://muchson.web.id/artikel/n8n-otomasi-workflow-untuk-pemula/): Kenali n8n, platform otomasi visual yang bisa dihosting sendiri. Pelajari konsep trigger dan node, contoh workflow, dan kapan n8n lebih cocok daripada menulis kode.
- [Membuat AI Agent dengan n8n: Langkah demi Langkah](https://muchson.web.id/artikel/membuat-ai-agent-dengan-n8n-langkah-demi-langkah/): Panduan merakit AI agent di n8n: memilih tugas sempit, model, alat, memori, dan batas keamanan agar agen tidak bertindak di luar kendali.
- [Claude Code untuk Pemula: Apa Itu dan Cara Mulai](https://muchson.web.id/artikel/claude-code-untuk-pemula-apa-itu-dan-cara-mulai/): Claude Code adalah agen coding yang bekerja langsung di folder proyek Anda. Pahami cara kerjanya, alur aman memakainya, dan batasannya.

### Belajar coding dan merancang pelatihan
- [Roadmap Belajar Python dari Nol: Urutan dan Latihannya](https://muchson.web.id/artikel/roadmap-belajar-python-dari-nol/): Urutan belajar Python yang masuk akal untuk pemula: dari variabel sampai proyek pertama, lengkap dengan target mingguan, latihan, dan kesalahan umum yang bikin berhenti.
- [Merancang Kurikulum Pelatihan: ADDIE dan Taksonomi Bloom](https://muchson.web.id/artikel/merancang-kurikulum-pelatihan-addie-dan-taksonomi-bloom/): Cara merancang kurikulum pelatihan yang efektif: kerangka ADDIE, tujuan belajar dengan taksonomi Bloom, dan pembuat tujuan belajar.
- [Portofolio Developer yang Dilirik Recruiter: Isi dan Contoh](https://muchson.web.id/artikel/portofolio-developer-yang-dilirik-recruiter/): Isi portofolio yang dilirik recruiter, cara menulis studi kasus proyek, kesalahan yang membuatnya diabaikan, dan daftar periksa lengkapnya.
- [Semua artikel](https://muchson.web.id/artikel/)

## Experience
- IT lecturer (remote, academy in Germany) (Jun 2025 – present): Teaches information technology to participants in a continuing-education programme.
- AI Project Manager, AITF Indonesia (freelance) (Sep 2025 – May 2026): Led and coordinated an AI talent development programme for 150 participants with university lecturers, Komdigi and the PMO; set up workflows in Trello and gave technical and non-technical mentoring. Reached a 100% module completion rate across three LMS tracks (Associate Data Science, Deep Learning, Advanced Data Science).
- Curriculum Developer, Digital Skola (freelance) (Apr 2025 – May 2026): Built curriculum modules and learning pathways aligned with industry demand, ran edutech market research and quality assurance of content.
- IT Trainer, Digital Talent Indonesia (Jan – Aug 2025): Designed an end-to-end front-end curriculum from JavaScript fundamentals to React and deployment. A 90% graduation rate with an average satisfaction score of 4.8/5.
- Learning and Development and Academic Project Coordinator, Alterra Academy (Jul 2021 – Dec 2024): Designed curricula for Green Digital Skills, web and mobile development (React, Vue, Angular, Flutter) and UI/UX. Managed national-scale projects with Kampus Merdeka, Prakerja, UN Women, UNHCR, Tanoto Foundation and Bappenas: 400+ learners and 20+ mentors with a 97% graduation rate and 4.9/5 satisfaction. Recognised as Best Mentor for the React Front-End programme.
